page_title: ARS 1-0 NEW | Arsenal v Newcastle 25/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Piero Hincapie (Arsenal) commits a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for an infringement. Newcastle are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90+7' The corner is swung in but Newcastle can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+6' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
90+4' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
90+3' Gabriel (Arsenal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Arsenal are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
89' Newcastle are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
88' The linesman makes the right call and Arsenal will have a corner.

87' That was a nice football moment. Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Nick Pope guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joe Willock departs the field of play to be replaced by Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd).
86' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Barrott had an easy-decision to make.
85' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
82' Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.

82' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
81' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Noni Madueke will be replaced by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
81' Substitution. Martin Zubimendi makes his way off the pitch and Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) comes on as his replacement.

80' Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
78' Arsenal hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
75' Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
75' Substitution. Bruno Guimaraes walks off the pitch and Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) comes on as a substitute.
71' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) has tested the patience of referee Samuel Barrott and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
69' 2:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
66' Here is a change. William Osula is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) will replace Jacob Murphy.
65' Declan Rice (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
62' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Noni Madueke (Arsenal).
59' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
58' That's unlucky! Noni Madueke (Arsenal) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
57' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
56' Neat passing move from Arsenal in order to create new attacking opportunities.
56' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:9.
53' Eberechi Eze is being substituted because of an injury. Mikel Arteta sends Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) on the pitch.
53' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
49' The Arsenal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Newcastle are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The Arsenal players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
44' The percentage of ball possession is – 52:48.
41' Great teamplay by Newcastle as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
41' Dangerous play by William Saliba (Arsenal). Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Newcastle.
38' An attempted cross from Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) is cleared.
36' Newcastle are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
34' Mikel Arteta is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Kai Havertz suffers an injury and Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) comes on.
33' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

30' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
30' The referee blows his whistle, Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
29' A cross into the box from Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) is cleared.
29' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Nick Pope comes off his line to intercept.
26' Arsenal spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
23' William Saliba (Arsenal) tackles a bit over-zealously and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul. Newcastle get a free kick.
22' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes.
21' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
20' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the roof of the net, but David Raya is equal to it and makes an easy save.
17' Newcastle enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
17' The attendance is 60204.
16' William Osula (Newcastle Utd) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
12' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Newcastle.
9' 1 - 0 Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) collects a good pass and blasts the ball from medium range into the top left corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
9' It's a corner kick for Newcastle.
9' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
9' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

8' Nice move, nice attempt! Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
7' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Noni Madueke (Arsenal) takes it short.
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Noni Madueke (Arsenal).
6' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) works the corner short.
6' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

4' That was close by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
3' Nice passing game by Newcastle. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
2' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nick Pope, who smothers the ball.
1' The first half has started.
Arsenal will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Samuel Barrott.
